author: Edduard
quote: I was playing for over 35 hours and I have to admit that this games is totally playable but I have to be honest. 30 fps is not the average in 2026. The people was expecting for over 10 years and if we compare this game vs RDR2 is not the game expected. I would to see honest review from this game because is definitely that this GTA saga needs to improve in next games.  Even though I'm waiting for new updates to se how the experiences improve for example in Ps5 pro
